components.name: Button
components.purpose: Primary action. One component, variants change material through tokens, never through a new geometry.

components.name: IconButton
components.purpose: Icon-only action. The tile corner and the glyph are token-driven; the state does not change the hue.

components.name: Link
components.purpose: Inline navigation. The label is a type token bound to the brand role.

components.name: FAB
components.purpose: Floating primary action. A pill by geometry, a brand token by material.

components.name: Input
components.purpose: Single-line field. The field plate, its border and its corner are the token surface; the host wrapper stays transparent.

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: Multi-line field. Same field token surface as Input; height is a rows decision, not a token.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Single-choice trigger plus popup. The trigger field uses the field role; rows bind by value to surface/text tokens.

components.name: Search
components.purpose: Search field. A field role with a leading search icon and an optional clear slot.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Binary selection. The box material and the label type are tokens; the check mark inherits the onBrand role.

components.name: Radio
components.purpose: One-of-many selection. Circles get circle corners; the ring takes the host's shape.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: Immediate on/off. The track and handle are token-bound; on/off changes material, not the corner.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: Continuous value. Track and fill use surface/brand roles; the handle is a circle.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Small status marker. A pill by default; tone changes the token, not the geometry.

components.name: Chip
components.purpose: Removable token/tag. A pill; the label and the remove affordance are separate slots.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: Identity marker. A circle takes the full corner; initials sit on the surfaceAlt role.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Raised content surface. The surface plate, corner and elevation are tokens; content is composed from instances.

components.name: Progress
components.purpose: Determinate progress. Track and bar are token surfaces, not two typed greys.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Section switcher. Selection is a fill/ink role; the corner depends on the tab material.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.purpose: Hierarchy trail. Links bind to text roles; the current item is not a link.

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Page navigation. The active page is a brand surface; the rest are text.

components.name: Alert
components.purpose: Inline message. Tone selects a wash+ink pair; the component itself has one geometry.

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: Transient notification. A raised surface with copy and an optional meter.

description.default: All changes are up to date.

defaults.title: Saved
defaults.description: All changes are up to date.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Short contextual copy. An inverse surface by token, never a typed dark hex.

components.name: Modal
components.purpose: Dialog surface and its footer actions. The panel is one raised plate; actions are Button instances.
